question: Can trusted mutation metadata soundly bypass the R10 exact complement-scan lower bound on the spectralDNS-compatible path?

observations: get_context constructs U_hat as Function(VT) and Source as Function(VT), exposing ordinary mutable array-like objects rather than a mutation-version abstraction.
ComputeRHS reads Source by rhs += Source after convection, Nyquist handling, pressure and diffusion.
set_velocity writes U_hat through VT.forward(U, U_hat); no support-generation metadata is updated in this pinned source.
generic solve calls integrate() before solver.update(context), consistent with the previously consumed R7/R8 step-boundary audit.

fixed RK4 performs four solver.ComputeRHS calls and mutates u0 in-place between stages; this is internal integrator mutation covered by the consumed carrier-closure premise, not external application mutation.
set_Source performs direct slice/index assignments (Source[:] = 0; Source[1] = ...), demonstrating an application-level raw mutable write surface without a mandatory generation hook.

result.raw_view_metadata_impossibility: If an outside-carrier coefficient can be changed by any unmediated raw write while metadata remains unchanged, metadata-only acceptance cannot exactly distinguish the no-write execution from the escaped-support execution.
sufficient_barrier_contract: All external writes to state and Source are mediated by a write barrier.
Each changed coefficient is tested exactly: if index is outside carrier and value != 0, latch permanent dense fallback.
No raw mutable view may escape the barrier. Any raw-view exposure revokes the metadata certificate and requires a full exact rescan or dense fallback.
Internal fixed-RK4 mutations may remain uninstrumented only under the previously consumed exact carrier-closure proof and no external mid-stage mutation.
A false escape latch may cost performance but must never lose a mode; clearing the latch requires a fresh exact recertification.
result.complexity: Under the complete mediation contract, exact external-mutation certification costs O(number of coefficients actually written through the barrier), bypassing the R10 O(|C^c|) passing-case scan lower bound because the information model has changed. Without complete mediation, the R10 lower bound remains binding.
result.pinned_host_conclusion: The pinned NS source itself supplies no trusted generation/dirty-set mechanism. Therefore a no-scan generation certificate is not justified by the existing pinned source/API alone.

brc_resolution.carrier: exact Boolean Fourier support only for sparse/dense route selection
brc_resolution.preserved_information: complex amplitudes, phase, wavevector labels, Nyquist handling, pressure/diffusion and RK stage state remain outside the support observer
brc_resolution.information_loss_boundary: metadata may replace a complement scan only after proving complete mutation mediation; raw mutable views invalidate the quotient.
